quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #13
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Prepare to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means no entry or prohibited. This sign means U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: When passing an emergency vehicle on the side of the road, you should:

options.text: Move away from that lane or slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move away from that lane or slow down.
questions.explanation: The Move Over Law protects emergency workers. If possible, move to another lane. If you cannot move safely, slow down.

questions.question: An emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches while you drive on a one-way street. You must:

options.text: Pull to the side of the road and stop.
Speed up and exit as soon as possible.
Slow down and let it pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the side of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches on a one-way street, pull to the nearest side of the road and stop.

questions.question: When driving on wet pavement, remember:

options.text: The road is most slippery when rain just starts.

questions.explanation: Wet roads are dangerous and slippery, especially when rain starts. Your tires sit on water, dirt, and oil. Slow down when roads are wet or have standing water.

questions.question: At a flashing red traffic light, you should:

options.text: Go through if no cars are coming.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Flashing red lights are used at dangerous intersections. Treat them like stop signs.

questions.question: A double solid yellow line in the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. You can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Solid lines mean no passing.

questions.question: If an oncoming car has its high beams on, look toward the ____ of the road.
questions.explanation: Look to the right side of the road when facing bright headlights. This keeps you from being blinded and helps you stay on course until the car passes.

questions.question: Where can you legally place an open alcohol container in your vehicle?
questions.explanation: It is illegal for anyone to drink alcohol in a vehicle. Open containers must be kept in the trunk.

questions.question: When a broken yellow line is on your side and a solid yellow line is on the other side, you may pass if:
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line on your side means you can pass. You may pass only if there is no oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entry from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entry from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in one direction only. You cannot enter from the opposite direction.

questions.question: A fire engine is following you on a two-lane street with no emergency lights on. What should you do?

options.text: Stop as quickly as you can.
Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down, move right, and stop.

questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is not using lights or sirens, you do not need to pull over. Continue driving normally.

questions.question: A driver entering interstate traffic from an entrance or acceleration ramp should:

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the interstate.
Assume other drivers will change lanes for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the interstate.
questions.explanation: When entering the interstate from a ramp, let drivers already on the highway go first. Merge safely when there is an opening.

questions.question: Two drivers arrive at the same time to a four-way stop intersection. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: One driver may continue without stopping.
One driver should honk to give up the right-of-way.

questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, the driver on your right has the right-of-way if you both arrive at the same time. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: When driving near a motorcycle, you must:

options.text: Give the motorcycle a full lane.
Drive on the shoulder next to the motorcycle.
Give the motorcycle only half a lane.
Share the same lane to pass the motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the motorcycle a full lane.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle is a full vehicle and needs a complete lane width to stay safe. Even though it seems small, it needs room to maneuver.

questions.question: You see an animal on the roadway. What should you do?

options.text: Pass the animal as close as possible.

questions.explanation: Always be very careful when you see an animal on the road. Pass it slowly to avoid scaring it.

questions.question: When a traffic light turns green, you should:

options.text: Wait for another driver to wave you forward.

questions.explanation: A green light means you can go. However, first let any pedestrians and other traffic still in the intersection pass.

questions.question: Defensive driving means:

options.text: Spotting danger and taking action to avoid accidents.
Beating poor drivers by passing them in traffic.
Following the car ahead very closely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spotting danger and taking action to avoid accidents.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means you see dangerous situations early and act to prevent accidents. It helps you stay safe from unsafe drivers and pedestrians.

questions.question: An emergency vehicle is approaching with flashing red or blue lights. What should you do?

options.text: Try to reach your destination before it catches up.
Keep driving but stay out of the way.
Pull to the side of the road and stop completely.
Stop in the middle of an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the side of the road and stop completely.
questions.explanation: You must yield to all emergency vehicles with lights or sirens. Pull to the right edge and stop. If you are in an intersection, drive through first, then pull over.

questions.question: Car drivers should know that large trucks:

options.text: Do not need extra room to turn and stop.

questions.explanation: Large trucks have big blind spots in front, on the sides, and in back. Avoid these areas. Trucks also need more space to turn and stop than cars because of their size and weight.

questions.question: You see an oncoming car on your left and a bicyclist on your right. What should you do?

options.text: Let the car pass, then pass the bike.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the car pass, then pass the bike.
questions.explanation: When you face multiple hazards, handle one at a time. Do not try to pass the bike while the car is coming. Instead, let the car pass first. Then pass the bike.

questions.question: Where are stop lines painted on the road?
questions.explanation: Stop lines are white lines painted across traffic lanes at intersections and pedestrian crosswalks. They show drivers exactly where to stop.

questions.question: Your accelerator gets stuck while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Reach down and try to pull it up.
Shift to neutral and press the brake steadily.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift to neutral and press the brake steadily.
questions.explanation: If your accelerator sticks, keep your eyes on the road. Shift into neutral right away. Press the brake pedal steadily. Pull off the road safely and turn off the engine.

questions.question: Which traffic light means you should slow down and be careful at an intersection?
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down, proceed carefully, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When changing lanes, what is important to do?

options.text: Make sure the lane is clear.

questions.explanation: Always signal before changing lanes. Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot. Make sure the new lane is clear before you move into it.
